itens.titulo: INTC Stock Tumbles After-Hours After Q3 PC Slump And Supply Bottlenecks Cloud Fourth-Quarter Guidance
itens.descricao: INTC Stock Tumbles After-Hours After Q3 PC Slump And Supply Bottlenecks Cloud Fourth-Quarter Guidance Yahoo Finance
trechos: INTC Stock Tumbles After-Hours After Q3 PC Slump And Supply Bottlenecks Cloud Fourth-Quarter Guidance - Intel reported third-quarter revenue of $16.5 billion, up 21% year-over-year, and earnings of $0.52 per share, beating analyst consensus estimates.
- Intel expects Q4 revenue to come in between $ 15 and $16 billion, below what analysts expect.

Intel Inc. (INTC) share price tumbled about 17% after-hours on Thursday after the company forecast weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter revenue and earnings amid a slump in persona; computer (PC) sales amid supply bottlenecks.
For the third quarter ended September 26, Intel posted total sales of $16.5 billion, marking a 21% increase from the same period last year and matching analysts' average predictions.
Adjusted earnings reached $0.52 per share, surpassing Wall Street's consensus estimate of $0.41 per share.
"Our immediate priority is to unlock additional supply to meet extraordinary demand for our Xeon family," CEO Lip-Bu Tan said.
An explosion occurred at Intel's Fab 28 semiconductor plant in Kiryat Gat, southern Israel on October 14, 2026.
"I am a bit disappointed in terms of how we cannot fulfill the customer requirements," Tan said in an interview to Bloomberg.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa cai 1,06%; dólar sobe 0,89% e vai a R$ 5,387
itens.descricao: Ibovespa cai 1,06%; dólar sobe 0,89% e vai a R$ 5,387 Poder360
trechos: O dólar comercial subiu 0,89% e encerrou o dia a R$ 5,387.
A dívida bruta do governo geral chegou a 82,9% do PIB (Produto Interno Bruto) em setembro, segundo dados divulgados pelo Banco Central.
Cenário internacional Nos Estados Unidos, o PIB cresceu a uma taxa anualizada de 3,4% no 3º trimestre.
O resultado ficou 1,2 p.p. acima do avanço de 2,2% do trimestre anterior.
O índice de preços dos gastos com consumo pessoal (PCE, na sigla em inglês), acompanhado pelo Federal Reserve (Fed, o banco central dos EUA), subiu 3,6% em 12 meses até setembro.
O núcleo do indicador, que exclui alimentos e energia, avançou 3,1% no período, ante 3% registrados anteriormente.
Os dados foram divulgados 1 dia depois de o Fed manter a taxa básica de juros dos EUA no intervalo de 3,75% a 4% ao ano.
A decisão teve 2 votos contrários, favoráveis a uma alta de 0,25 p.p.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa cai pela 4ª sessão e acumula perda de 17,5% desde a eleição; dólar vai a R$ 5,38
itens.descricao: Ibovespa cai pela 4ª sessão e acumula perda de 17,5% desde a eleição; dólar vai a R$ 5,38 Exame
trechos: Ibovespa: índice fechou em queda de 1,06% nesta quinta-feira, 29, aos 169.186,42 pontos, na quarta sessão consecutiva de perdas (Germano Lüders/Exame) Publicado em 29 de outubro de 2026 às 17h39.
Última atualização em 29 de outubro de 2026 às 17h43.
O Ibovespa fechou em queda de 1,06% nesta quinta-feira, 29, aos 169.186,42 pontos, na quarta sessão consecutiva de perdas.
O principal índice da B3 oscilou entre a mínima de 168.765,35 pontos e a máxima de 171.402,97 pontos ao longo do pregão.
O volume financeiro somou R$ 31 bilhões.
Desde o fechamento da sexta-feira anterior ao segundo turno, quando estava na casa dos 205 mil pontos, o Ibovespa acumula perda de 17,5%.
O dólar à vista também encerrou em alta, de 0,89%, a R$ 5,387, após oscilar entre R$ 5,343 e R$ 5,429.
A moeda teve mais uma sessão de volatilidade em meio às preocupações com os planos econômicos do novo governo Lula 4.

itens.titulo: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
itens.descricao: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate CNBC
trechos: Revenue came in at $45.98 billion, up 39% year over year and above the $45.29 billion consensus among analysts polled by StreetAccount, according to a statement.
Growth in the second quarter came in at about 37%.
"Our core compute and storage revenue grew at their fastest rates in several years," Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on a conference call with analysts.
The AWS growth rate was the highest since the fourth quarter of 2021.
The AWS segment generated $17.77 billion in third-quarter operating income, up 55% and more than the $16.97 billion StreetAccount consensus.
The unit now accounts for almost 23% of Amazon's revenue, a record.
Azure is 72% the size of AWS, up from 58% two years ago.
AWS came before Azure and the Google Cloud Platform, with its first services appearing in 2006.

trechos: In contrast, the smallcap Russell 2000 advanced 1.0%.

Semiconductor stocks snapped their four-day winning streak, dropping 1.4% as investors sought to distinguish between companies that can fund their lofty AI ambitions and those that burn through cash and borrow funds to realize their goals.
Its shares slid 12.6%, dragging the communication services sector down with it.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 132.54 points, or 0.25%, to 52,342.56, the S&P 500 lost 23.59 points, or 0.30%, to 7,720.39 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 365.13 points, or 1.37%, to 26,184.72.
Third-quarter earnings season has crossed the halfway point, with 253 of the companies in the S&P 500 having reported.
Of those, 81% have beaten analyst expectations, according to the most recent LSEG data.
Analysts now expect aggregate third-quarter S&P 500 earnings growth of 31.0%, year-on-year, per LSEG.
The heavy equipment maker's shares tumbled 9.3%.
